mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guardianship g JOIN consent c ON c.subject_user_id=g.parent_user_id AND c.student_id=g.student_id WHERE g.student_id=s.id AND g.status='LINKED' AND c.document_id=(SELECT d.id FROM consent_document d WHERE d.kind='COMMUNITY' AND d.effective_from <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date ORDER BY d.effective_from DESC, d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT 1) AND c.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM consent latest WHERE latest.document_id=c.document_id AND latest.subject_user_id=g.parent_user_id AND latest.student_id=s.id ORDER BY latest.agreed_at DESC, latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) AND c.agreed AND c.status='AGREED' AND c.withdrawn_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT s.community_enabled, s.community_updated_at, AS consent_granted FROM student s WHERE s.id=#{studentId} AND s.status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE OF s
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET community_enabled=#{enabled}, community_updated_at=#{now}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{studentId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE student SET community_enabled=false, community_updated_at=#{now}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{studentId} AND community_enabled
UPDATE student SET community_enabled=false, community_updated_at=NULL WHERE id=#{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT status, review_result FROM error_report WHERE target_type='COMMUNITY_POST' AND target_id=#{postId}
